steps: Remove jewelry and metal. You may wear a gown.

Get right back to your day. Results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours.

captions.gbp:
Have an X-ray coming up? Here's what to expect at Advanced Medical Imaging in Seminole. Most X-rays need no special preparation: just leave jewelry and metal at home, and you may change into a gown. You stand, sit or lie still for a few seconds while the image is taken, and you may be asked to hold your breath briefly. Several angles may be taken. X-rays are painless, and most visits take under 30 minutes. The dose is low: one chest X-ray is about the same as 10 days of everyday background radiation. If you are or might be pregnant, tell us first. Results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. Self-pay X-ray is $50 per body part, radiologist reading included, with no referral needed and same-day visits often available.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

carousel: A clinician in a mask and safety glasses holds up a chest X-ray. Painless. Done in minutes.

How your visit goes: check in, remove jewelry and metal, and you may wear a gown; stand, sit or lie still for a few seconds and maybe hold your breath briefly; get back to your day, with results to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours.
What it feels like: nothing at all. X-rays are painless, some positions may feel awkward, most visits are under 30 minutes, and a chest X-ray is about 10 days of everyday background radiation.
Before your X-ray: most need no special prep; leave jewelry at home and wear comfy clothes; tell us first if you are or might be pregnant; if using insurance, bring your card and your doctor's order.
Simple to book in Seminole: $50 self-pay per body part, no referral needed for self-pay, same day often for self-pay, results to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours.
